verdict.rationale: The project's own GitHub README states that Gitea provides an official go-sdk, alongside an API it markets for extending the product. Only one language is evidenced, and support rests on a single brief mention with no SDK documentation or usage reports. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Go, first-party SDK documentation and reference, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (docs-site probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK's quality.
